_about: Samuel Rutherford (1600?-1661) texts missing from lane A's rutherford_shelf.json, kept as a separate shelf (the chesterton-gaps precedent) so lane A's file is never edited. Lane A refused christd00ruth because its OCR breaks his name; the second Princeton scan of the same 1647 edition reads 'By Samuel Rutherfurd' on its title page and is held instead. The Survey of the Spiritual Antichrist survives only as the 1648 first edition (EEBO microfilm). All three are first printings in old type, so expect long-s errors. The surname check takes both spellings. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

rutherford-christ-dying-1647: Christ Dying and Drawing Sinners to Himself (London, 1647)
rutherford-spiritual-antichrist-1648: A Survey of the Spiritual Antichrist, opening the secrets of Familism and Antinomianism (London, 1648; EEBO scan)
rutherford-peaceable-plea-1642: A Peaceable and Temperate Plea for Paul's Presbyterie in Scotland (London, 1642)

_alternates.christd00ruth: First Princeton scan of Christ Dying (1647); OCR breaks the name.
_alternates.peapera00ruth, bim_early-english-books-1: Other scans of the Peaceable Plea (1642).

_pending.Rutherfurd's Catechism, in A. F. Mitchel: An edited collection by Mitchell; better as its own catechisms shelf.
